## About

I am a PhD candidate in Economics at the [Laboratoire d'Économie d'Orléans (LEO)](https://www.leo-univ-orleans.fr/en/){target="_blank" rel="noopener"}, University of Orléans, and a research scientist at [Square Management](https://www.square-management.com/){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} through the French CIFRE programme. I work under the supervision of [Professor Christophe Hurlin](https://sites.google.com/view/christophe-hurlin/home){target="_blank" rel="noopener"}.

My research develops robust econometric, Bayesian, and sequential-testing methods to measure and monitor emerging risks in credit portfolios. At Square Management I conduct research and advisory work for banking institutions on probability-of-default calibration, model validation, and stress testing.

From September to December 2026, I will be a **Visiting Student Researcher** in the [Department of Statistics at Stanford University](https://statistics.stanford.edu/){target="_blank" rel="noopener"}, hosted by [Professor Aaditya Ramdas](https://web.stanford.edu/~aramdas/){target="_blank" rel="noopener"}, working on sequential and anytime-valid inference.

<div class="interests">
<strong>Research interests:</strong> financial econometrics · credit risk modelling and model validation · stress testing · Bayesian and sequential inference · sequential testing · time series and forecasting · climate risk.
</div>
